此工作流程适用于 Anima Aesthetic 1.0b 文本到图像。它被设计为动画图像生成的替代美学比较版本。不应该简单地用比Anima Aesthetic 1.0更强来形容。它的价值在于，它为创作者提供了另一个审美方向来与主要的1.0模型进行比较。

该工作流程使用anima_aestheticV10b.safetensors作为主模型，qwen_3_06b_base.safetensors作为文本编码器，qwen_image_vae.safetensors作为VAE。管道保持干净和直接：文本提示、负提示、潜在图像、KSampler、VAE 解码和保存图像。

默认设置为 40 步骤、CFG 4.0、欧拉采样器、简单调度器和完全降噪。推荐使用与 1.0 工作流程类似：动漫风格的插图、角色艺术、封面图像、风格化的幻想场景、干净的构图和精美的视觉资源。区别不在于工作流程的复杂性，而在于模型的审美倾向和视觉反应。

当您想要比较两个相关的 Anima Aesthetic 模型如何处理相同的提示时，此版本非常有用。您可以使用相同的种子、相同的提示、相同的大小和相同的采样设置，然后比较构图、线条质量、颜色行为、角色设计、纹理密度和整体氛围。

工作流程仅是纯文本到图像。它不需要参考图像、掩模、ControlNet 或图像编辑输入。它最好用作干净的模型比较路线和替代的美学渲染选项。

主要特点：

  • Anima Aesthetic 1.0b 文本到图像工作流程

  • 另一种审美比较路线

  • anima_aestheticV10b.safetensors 模型

  • qwen_3_06b_base.safetensors 文本编码器

  • qwen_image_vae.safetensors VAE

  • 40步质量生成

  • CFG 4.0 设置

  • 欧拉采样器

  • 简单的调度程序

  • 1024×1024默认潜在尺寸

  • 正负提示控制

  • 纯文本到图像的工作流程

  • 适用于模型对比、动漫插画、人物美术、风格化图像测试

建议的工作流程：

在 Anima Aesthetic 1.0 旁边使用此工作流程，并在同一提示下比较结果。不要仅以速度来判断。查看美学方向、色彩平衡、角色设计、构图、背景处理和细节稳定性。如果输出样式比 1.0 更适合您的项目，请将其用作该批次的主要渲染选择。如果没有，请将其保留为比较模型以便及时测试。

o.en:
This workflow is for Anima Aesthetic 1.0b Text-to-Image. It is designed as an alternate aesthetic comparison version for Anima image generation. It should not be described as simply stronger than Anima Aesthetic 1.0. Its value is that it gives creators another aesthetic direction to compare against the main 1.0 model.

The workflow uses anima_aestheticV10b.safetensors as the main model, qwen_3_06b_base.safetensors as the text encoder, and qwen_image_vae.safetensors as the VAE. The pipeline remains clean and direct: text prompt, negative prompt, latent image, KSampler, VAE Decode, and Save Image.

The default setup is 40 steps, CFG 4.0, euler sampler, simple scheduler, and full denoise. Recommended use is similar to the 1.0 workflow: anime-style illustration, character art, cover images, stylized fantasy scenes, clean compositions, and polished visual assets. The difference is not workflow complexity, but the model’s aesthetic tendency and visual response.

This version is useful when you want to compare how two related Anima Aesthetic models handle the same prompt. You can use the same seed, same prompt, same size, and same sampling settings, then compare composition, line quality, color behavior, character design, texture density, and overall atmosphere.

The workflow is pure text-to-image only. It does not require reference images, masks, ControlNet, or image editing inputs. It is best used as a clean model comparison route and as an alternate aesthetic rendering option.

Main features:

  • Anima Aesthetic 1.0b text-to-image workflow

  • Alternate aesthetic comparison route

  • anima_aestheticV10b.safetensors model

  • qwen_3_06b_base.safetensors text encoder

  • qwen_image_vae.safetensors VAE

  • 40-step quality generation

  • CFG 4.0 setup

  • euler sampler

  • simple scheduler

  • 1024×1024 default latent size

  • Positive and negative prompt control

  • Pure text-to-image workflow

  • Suitable for model comparison, anime illustration, character art, and stylized image testing

Suggested workflow:

Use this workflow beside Anima Aesthetic 1.0 and compare results under the same prompt. Do not judge it only by speed. Look at aesthetic direction, color balance, character design, composition, background handling, and detail stability. If the output style fits your project better than 1.0, use it as the main rendering choice for that batch. If not, keep it as a comparison model for prompt testing.
